what: CORRECT seeded, variable-latency, interleaved multi-HAID pick stream. The gate folds it through the impl (issue_claim.simulate_claim_stream) AND the independent reference (reference.fold), normalizes to the served-claim partition, and diffs. They MUST be identical over every seed. Exercises one-owner-per-issue-per-team (a race that only one teammate wins), team isolation (the SAME issue id served in BOTH teams), and TTL-reap→re-pick (a dropped claim's issue re-granted after its window). A false-RED here means the gate rejects its own golden and is itself broken.
